name: Numata (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Numata town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing a saltire.
history: Municipal flag of Numata, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 8 May 1954.

features.role: Numata town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a saltire
